articles.title: McMahon plans to 'fire' herself from a job, striving to show Congress that the Department of Ed is not needed
articles.summary: Linda McMahon is shifting Department of Education functions to the departments of Labor and Treasury through interagency agreements as proof of concept.
articles.body: U.S. Education Secretary Linda McMahon doubled down on closing the Department of Education (ED) as planned to demonstrate to Congress that the federal agency she leads is no longer necessary. "Signing these interagency agreements means, in fact, that the Department of Education is contracting with these agencies to perform the functions that they've been given," McMahon told Fox News Digital. "The first big block of work was transferred over to the Department of Labor." Throughout his 2024 presidential campaign, Donald Trump promised to eliminate the ED, later signing an executive order directing his administration to begin dismantling the agency. MCMAHON EMBARKS ON FOUR-STATE TOUR TO PUT LOCAL LEADERS AND PARENTS 'BACK INTO THE DRIVER’S SEAT' OF EDUCATION As part of that effort, the Department of Labor (DOL) is taking on a major role in the day-to-day administration of adult education, family literacy and career and technical education (CTE) programs under the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA) and the Perkins Act. While Labor manages operational duties, the Department of Education retains statutory responsibilities and oversight while shifting services to states and grant recipients. "It started first with CTE — Career and Technical Education — then K–12 and finally higher education as well," McMahon said. McMahon explained that she wants to show lawmakers that federal support for students won't falter without a standalone Cabinet department. "I've asked Congress with this proof of concept in these interagency agreements: 'Let me prove to you that it works,'" she said. "Ultimately, Congress has to vote if we do close the Department of Education, and if I, in fact, am able to fire myself. Hopefully, they will vote [for it], because I believe the outcome will be better for students, and that is the goal. That is certainly the president's goal." TRUMP ADMIN URGES RETURNING EDUCATION TO STATES, CITING $3 TRILLION OF TAXES SPENT AND POOR PROFICIENCY SCORES The agency took another major step by partnering with the Department of the Treasury, which agreed to take over key operations related to federal student loans and collections on defaulted debt. The student loan partnership with Treasury and the workforce initiative with DOL are part of a broader series of interagency agreements. According to Department of Education officials, the goal is to demonstrate a "proof of concept" to Congress that essential federal education functions and funding flows can be successfully reallocated across executive branch agencies without disruption. "I call it my proof of concept to show Congress that it works, that the money still gets to schools and to students where they need it," McMahon told Fox News Digital. "Some of the programs in the Department of Education were being duplicated in other agencies or handled better elsewhere," McMahon added. "So, let's be efficient. Let's make sure the money gets where it needs to go, let's measure that by student outcomes and let's hold teachers and administrators accountable for what they're doing." Andrew Gillen, a higher education policy research fellow at the Cato Institute, told Fox News Digital that shifting major core duties like student loans and formula grants marks a substantial change from previous interagency agreements, which historically focused on minor administrative support. McMahon previously argued during the government shutdown that the ED acts primarily as a pass-through entity for federal money, contending that its day-to-day functions are nonessential. "Congress appropriates the funds. The funds come through the Department of Education, and some of that funding still goes to other agencies to get to students and schools," McMahon told Fox News Digital. "Primarily, the money was passed through the Department of Education to then get to the states and local authorities for education." TRUMP ADMINISTRATION TARGETS HEAD START BUREAUCRACY IN MOVE ADVOCATES SAY PUTS PARENTS IN THE DRIVER'S SEAT ED announced earlier this year that the agency moved out of the Lyndon B. Johnson Department of Education building so the Department of Energy could move in by August. The move is what the officials call "a prudent step to save hundreds of millions of taxpayer dollars and further reduce the federal education bureaucracy." The Trump administration is also seeking to reduce the department's footprint by returning more power to the states. The ED launched a new process allowing states to seek greater flexibility in using federal education funds and reducing administrative burdens. Iowa became the first state to participate in the effort. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP The Department of Education sent states a letter in July 2025 encouraging them to apply for the waiver, which would give state education officials more discretion over federal dollars and reduce compliance costs.

articles.title: Tribunal rejects fine only for filing I-T return after notice
articles.summary: MUMBAI: The Mumbai bench of Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) has ruled that taxpayers cannot be penalised simply because they filed their income tax
articles.body: MUMBAI: The Mumbai bench of Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) has ruled that taxpayers cannot be penalised simply because they filed their income tax return after receiving a notice under Section 148 to reopen their case. If the income-tax (I-T) officer accepts the income declared without adding any undisclosed income, a penalty cannot be automatically imposed.According to tax experts, this ord­er could help curb the mechanical levy of income tax penalties in reassessment cases or give taxpayers who have found themselves on the receiving end of such penalties a stronger footing in litigation.In this case, ITAT deleted a penalty of nearly Rs. 4 lakh imposed under Se­ction 270A, emphasising the provision must be read as a whole and a failure to file an I-T return within the prescribed time is distinct from actual under-reporting of income. Section 270A provides for a penalty where income has been under-reported or misreported.The taxpayer, a ship captain, had not filed his I-T return within the time prescribed under Section 139(1). Subsequently, the I-T department initiated reassessment proceedings on getting information about his purchase of immovable property worth Rs 1.4 crore, salary receipts and interest income.In response to a notice under Secti­on 148, he filed a return declaring a total income of nearly Rs 31.6 lakh. He fu­rnished supporting documents, including bank statements, a housing loan certificate and details of investments redeemed to fund the purchase. The I-T officer accepted the dec­l­ared income without making any addition or variation. The salary in­come had already suffered tax deducted at source (TDS) and was rep­o­rted by the employer. The property investment was also explained th­r­o­ugh a housing loan and sale of investments.Despite fully accepting the taxable income as disclosed by the taxpayer, the department treated the ass­e­ssed income as under-reported and im­­pos­ed nearly Rs 4 lakh penalty. The first appellate authority upheld the levy.Setting aside the pe­n­alty, ITAT held the mere fact that a return was furnished for the first time under Section 148 did not mean that the entire assessed income automatically qualified as under-reported income. The bench noted the income was already reported through the TDS mechanism, the property investment was explained, and no su­p­pressed or unexplained income was found. These circ­u­mstances supported the bona fide nature of his explanat­i­on. ITAT, in its order, clarified the abs­e­nce of an outsta­n­ding tax demand, by itself, does not rule out a penalty. How­ever, full disclosure of income, deduction of tax at source and acceptance of return without additions were significant factors in favour of the taxpayer.A chartered accountant said, “This order reinforces the need to examine the facts and statutory exclusions before imposing penalties, rather than treat­i­ng delayed filing or a return under Section 148 as sufficient grounds for a levy. It could help curb mechanical penalties in reassessment proc­e­edings, while leaving intact the department’s power to penalise genuine under-reporting where the law permits it.”You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Mumbai | Silver Rate in Mumbai | Bank Holidays in Mumbai | Public Holidays in Mumbai | Mumbai AQI | Weather in Mumbai | Petrol Price in Mumbai | Diesel Price in Mumbai | CNG Price in Mumbai | LPG Price in MumbaiStay updated with the latest Mumbai news. articles.title: UP Board exams 2027: UPMSP sets October 26 deadline for schools to submit classes 9 to 12 student lists
articles.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad (UPMSP) has given 940 schools a final opportunity to complete the pending student registration process for
articles.body: The Uttar Pradesh Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad (UPMSP) has given 940 schools a final opportunity to complete the pending student registration process for the 2026-27 academic session. According to a notice issued by the board on October 23, the schools must generate and download the student lists from the board's portal and submit them by October 26, 2026.The deadline applies to advance registration for Classes 9 and 11 and examination applications for Classes 10 and 12. Schools must submit a copy of the student lists along with the required challan to the office of the District School Inspector.The board had initially set October 15 as the deadline. It later extended the date to October 22. However, 940 schools had still not generated the required lists by the revised deadline, prompting the board to issue another notice.The latest notice states that the concerned schools must complete the process by October 26. articles.title: La rotonda más profunda del mundo y en forma de medusa: a 187 metros de profundidad en un túnel submarino de 11,2 km de longitud
articles.standfirst: Una glorieta decorada con luces y figuras humanas situada a unos 72 metros bajo el agua
articles.summary: Una glorieta decorada con luces y figuras humanas situada a unos 72 metros bajo el agua
articles.body: Conducir por una carretera y encontrarse con una rotonda es algo habitual. Hacerlo bajo el océano, rodeado de roca y luces de colores, es una experiencia mucho menos común. En las islas Feroe, un archipiélago del Atlántico Norte perteneciente al Reino de Dinamarca, existe una infraestructura que combina ingeniería y arte en un mismo espacio. Se trata de la conocida como “rotonda medusa”, situada en el interior del Eysturoyartunnilin, un túnel submarino de 11,2 kilómetros inaugurado en diciembre de 2020. La construcción conecta la isla de Streymoy, donde se encuentra la capital, Tórshavn, con la de Eysturoy y varias de sus localidades. Su diseño permite que tres ramales confluyan en una misma glorieta bajo el fiordo de Skálafjørður, de manera que los conductores pueden cambiar de dirección sin salir a la superficie. Aunque el túnel llega a alcanzar los 187 metros bajo el nivel del mar en su punto más profundo, la rotonda se encuentra a unos 72 metros bajo la superficie del agua. El elemento más llamativo de esta infraestructura es su decoración. En el centro de la rotonda se conservó un gran pilar de roca natural que el artista feroés Tróndur Patursson convirtió en el eje de una instalación artística. A su alrededor se extiende una escultura de acero de unos 80 metros de longitud, formada por figuras humanas que se dan la mano y evocan una danza tradicional de las islas Feroe. La iluminación azulada y verdosa contribuye a crear una imagen que recuerda a una medusa suspendida en la oscuridad, de ahí el nombre con el que se conoce popularmente. Sin embargo, el proyecto va mucho más allá de su atractivo visual. La construcción responde a una necesidad práctica en un territorio formado por 18 islas, donde las montañas, los fiordos y las condiciones meteorológicas han dificultado históricamente los desplazamientos. Antes de la apertura del túnel, viajar por carretera entre Tórshavn y Runavík podía llevar alrededor de 64 minutos y exigir un recorrido de unos 55 kilómetros. Con esta conexión, el trayecto se redujo a aproximadamente 16 minutos y 17 kilómetros. La infraestructura cuenta con dos carriles y una pendiente máxima del 5 %, características que facilitan la circulación a través de sus más de 11 kilómetros. Además, forma parte de una red de túneles submarinos que ha transformado la movilidad en el archipiélago y ha reducido el aislamiento de numerosas localidades. El éxito de esta conexión también se refleja en su uso cotidiano. Durante 2025, más de 2,3 millones de vehículos atravesaron el Eysturoyartunnilin, una media superior a los 6.000 desplazamientos diarios. Así, la “rotonda medusa” se ha convertido tanto en un símbolo de la ingeniería moderna como en una infraestructura esencial para los habitantes de las islas Feroe.

articles.title: Arturo Pérez Reverte atiza a la clase política: "Míralos, son oportunistas todos, sin escrúpulos, analfabetos en buena parte"
articles.standfirst: El escritor recupera su reflexión sobre el debate entre la República y la Monarquía
articles.summary: El escritor recupera su reflexión sobre el debate entre la República y la Monarquía
articles.body: Arturo Pérez Reverte, escritor, ha recuperado una entrevista suya en 'El Hormiguero', hace dos años, en el que el presentador, Pablo Motos, le preguntaba sobre el debate entre una monarquía o una república. "Quizá sean días adecuados para recordar esto", ha indicado en redes sociales. Y ha publicado el vídeo de la conversación. "Yo soy republicano, por educación, por formación, por cultura, por lo que sea. Tengo una formación republicana. Soy republicano, pero soy español y ahí es donde surge el factor condicionante", afirmó el académico de la RAE en el programa de Antena 3. Arturo Pérez Reverte indicó que en nuestro país, en su opinión, no hay ninguna persona capacitada para liderar una hipotética República: "Está presidida por una persona de prestigio, serena, culta, estable... Alguien capaz de aglutinar y de administrar desde un punto de vista superior, de dar la serenidad a un país que le confía la presidencia. Dime en España una sola persona, una, que pueda hacer ese papel. No hay ninguna. En este momento no hay nadie de ese nivel". El académico de la Real Academia Española criticó con dureza a los dirigentes actuales. "Una República en manos de la infame clase política que nos está dirigiendo en la derecha y en la izquierda y en los radicales también sería un caos. Míralos. Son oportunistas todos, sin escrúpulos, analfabetos en buena parte... Para hacer un ciudadano honorable y educado hacen falta años de educación. Para hacer un fanático bastan cinco minutos de redes sociales", ha puntualizado. La consecuencia, para Arturo Pérez Reverte, es abrazar la monarquía: "Cuando ves ese panorama dices... ¿Y a esa gente voy a confiarles una República? Mi vejez, mi pensión de jubilación, mi hija, mis nietos si los tengo. ¿Dónde vas? Pues a ser monárquico en defensa propia. El rey viejo lo hizo muy bien en muchas cosas y muy mal en otras y está pagando sus errores. Además, creo que morirá en el exilio, no creo que vuelva en vida". En este sentido, Arturo Pérez Reverte ha defendido la figura de Felipe VI. "Es un tipo sereno, culto, ama a España, tiene patriotismo real. Y no es Borbón, es Grecia. Se parece más a su madre que a su padre. Es una muy buena persona. Es un hombre que hace lo que puede", ha explicado.

articles.title: El Nido del Águila de Hitler, en llamas: "Es poco probable que pueda recuperarse"
articles.standfirst: La policía detiene a una persona sospechosa de provocar el incendio
articles.summary: La policía detiene a una persona sospechosa de provocar el incendio
articles.body: La casa del dictador alemán Adolf Hitler, en la ciudad de Berchtesgaden, en los Alpes de Baviera, conocida popularmente como el 'Nido del Águila', sufrió un incendio durante la noche del viernes. La policía de Baviera, según ha informado el diario germano Bild, ha detenido a un hombre de 33 años, en motocicleta, sospechoso de haber provocado las llamas. Las primeras informaciones de este medio señalan que podría sufrir algún desequilibrio mental. Las autoridades han informado al Bild que la casa de Hitler, que no sufrió daños durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, puede haber recibido en esta ocasión un revés definitivo: "Los daños son considerables. Es poco probable que pueda recuperarse". Pese a las espectaculares imágenes del 'Nido del Águila', no se ha producido heridos debido a las llamas. Unos 200 efectivos han participado en la extinción del incendio, que todavía sigue activo. La policía recibió el aviso del incendio el viernes por la noche, a las 21:15 horas e inició el operativo para extinguir las llamas en el edificio. El suceso ha inundado titulares y redes sociales. El 'Nido del Águila' o Kehlsteinhaus, casa del pico de Kehlstein, a 1.834 metros, era la casa utilizada por el dictador alemán Adolf Hitler para realizar recepciones diplomáticas. El Partido Nazi se la regaló a Hitler por su quincuagésimo cumpleaños. Algunas fuentes indican que realmente el dictador no visitaba en exceso el 'Nido del Águila', pero sí que se usó en cumbres clave, para planificar la invasión rusa, o como escenario para vídeos de propaganda nazi, según explica la BBC. Actualmente, la casa es un destino turístico habitual e incluso se ha habilitado un restaurante. Al menos, así ha sido hasta el incendio de este viernes 23 de octubre. Probablemente, según han informado las autoridades a Bild, las llamas hayan acabado con el 'Nido del Águila' por completo.
